newsitem.title: USA: Delta to buy four planes for Delta Express.
newsitem.headline: Delta to buy four planes for Delta Express.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to buy four Boeing 757 aircraft from American International Group unit International Lease Finance Corporation for an undisclosed price.
The aircraft are currently operated by American Trans Air. They are to be delivered to Delta during the fourth quarter, the company said.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.
Delta said the planes will be used by the Delta Express low-fare operation, which begins October 1.
